description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 19 Cricket Fields, a beautifully presented four-bedroom owner-occupied family residence situated just off the Dunmore Road in Tuam.

This exceptional home has been lovingly maintained and thoughtfully upgraded by its current owners and is presented in turnkey condition. Overlooking a magnificent green area to the front, the property enjoys an abundance of natural light together with a safe and spacious recreational area for children, creating an idyllic family setting.

This home is immediately impressively on arrival, where attractive wrought iron railings, beautifully maintained lawns, a handsome brick façade and a welcoming porch finished with Victorian-style tiling combine to create superb kerb appeal.

The bright, spacious entrance hallway features a generous double-width layout with the staircase cleverly positioned to the rear, creating a wonderful sense of openness upon entering the home.

The kitchen and dining area is particularly impressive, boasting a newly fitted high-gloss contemporary kitchen complete with integrated appliances and ample workspace. The adjoining dining area is flooded with natural light and enjoys pleasant views across the green to the front, making it an ideal space for everyday family living and entertaining.

Positioned on the opposite side of the home is an exceptionally spacious living room, where light flows effortlessly from front to back. This elegant space offers generous proportions, a feature fireplace and patio doors leading directly to the beautifully landscaped rear garden.

Outside, the rear garden has been thoughtfully designed to provide an outstanding outdoor living space, featuring an attractive brick patio, manicured lawns, mature hedging for privacy and a practical storage shed. A standout feature is the fully insulated external office, complete with power and lighting, providing the perfect solution for remote working or a wide variety of additional uses.

A generously sized utility room together with a beautifully presented guest WC complete the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, a spacious landing leads to four beautifully appointed bedrooms. The impressive master suite offers generous floor space, extensive wall-to-wall fitted wardrobes and a stylish ensuite bathroom. Two further double bedrooms overlook the green to the front and both benefit from built-in storage, while a fourth spacious double bedroom to the rear also features fitted wardrobes, ensuring excellent accommodation for the growing family.

If you are searching for a modern, attractive family home that has been meticulously maintained, is presented in turnkey condition in one of Tuams most sought-after residential locations, then look no further than No. 19 Cricket Fields. This outstanding property is certain to exceed your expectations.

Brought to You By Fair Deal Property – Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
